WEB ANIMATION SUGGESTION
Display each pose for 500–800 ms. Crossfade between neighboring frames for
120–180 ms. Keep the dancer anchored at bottom-center and use object-fit:
contain so the feet do not jump. For a calmer scroll section, reveal one pose
per scroll step instead of playing all poses automatically.
